# Wolfsong Wear

> Small-batch screen-printed clothing from a print room in Missoula, Montana, USA: heavyweight tees, long-sleeve tees, crewnecks, hoodies and rib-knit beanies carrying original night-forest and wolf artwork, printed by hand in water-based inks. Ships within the United States only.

## Prices (USD)
- Heavyweight tee: $34
- Long-sleeve tee: $40
- Crewneck sweatshirt: $58
- Pullover hoodie: $68
- Zip hoodie: $74
- Rib-knit beanie: $26
- Gift wrap: $4 per parcel

- /returns-policy.html: returns, refunds and exchanges

## Not offered
Custom or logo printing for other people, borrowed characters or band art, wholesale below a full drop, shipping outside the US.

Contact: howl@wolfsongwear.com
